market_question: Will Czechia win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
reasoning: Czechia is not a realistic contender for the 2026 World Cup; their true win probability is orders of magnitude lower than the 0.3% implied by the market. They failed to qualify for the last edition and lack the world-class talent depth needed to beat the top ~10‑12 nations over seven matches.
evidence_points: Czechia did not qualify for the 2022 FIFA World Cup and has only reached one World Cup (2006, group‑stage exit) since the dissolution of Czechoslovakia.
As of end‑2024, Czechia sits ~40th in the FIFA rankings and 30th+ in Elo, far behind the handful of teams that historically win World Cups.
Leading betting markets price Czechia at roughly 500‑1000:1 to win the 2026 World Cup, implying a probability well below 0.1%.
